## Accepted partial result, first attempt 1/5

Problem 30001933 / OWR-11451-006, rank 1238. The general rooted-arborescence Integer Carathéodory Property (ICP) question remains unresolved by this work.

The complete authored symbolic proofs and mathematical audit establish:

1. Cactus underlying graph after root deletion implies membership in the Gijswijt–Regts sufficient splitting class C, hence ICP, including parallel arcs and disconnected cactus components.
2. Every rooted directed multigraph on at most four vertices belongs to C.
3. An explicit five-vertex eight-arc graph lies outside C because P ∩ (1−P) has a fractional vertex. Five is the sharp vertex-count threshold for this stronger-property failure.
4. The same example still has ICP by an explicit TU matching-flow lift and the published projection theorem.

The unique integer-linear lift argument, complete universal cactus construction, exact symbolic fractional-vertex proof, and full forest/matching case analysis are retained. The corrected nonunique-lift witness is {a,c,e,g}; the audit preserves the explanation of why the earlier pair {a,b} was infeasible.

The sufficient class, TU implication and coordinate-projection theorem are credited to [Gijswijt–Regts](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jctb.2011.04.004). The exact fixed-root target is [Oberwolfach Report 53/2011, Question 2](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/11451). [Lancini–Pisanu, Open Question 8.6](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cosrev.2026.100928) is recent recorded evidence of the question, without certifying global openness or historical novelty.

## Review limits and edition boundary

The work is AI-assisted and unrefereed. Scoped acceptance is not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. No novelty, minimum arc count, greedy decomposition theorem, ICP counterexample or general-target resolution is claimed.

The entire computational-results section and scattered supplementary enumeration/determinant-check claims are omitted. Programs, generated computational results/certificates, fixtures, imported dataset contents, source document bodies and private coordination material are excluded, without copying them into prose. The mathematical examples and every symbolic proof remain complete. Public source PDF byte identities, citations and recorded inspection/version limits are supplied as metadata. Edition preparation performs no new source retrieval, PDF rehash, source inspection or literature search. Survey body inspection used retained final-copy bytes because the audit could not retrieve the direct institutional PDF endpoint.

Exactly six files are added under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30001933/. QUEUE.md and every unrelated entry are unchanged. This remains substantive attempt 1/5; editorial preparation adds no proof turn or accounting reset.

Strict clean-patch replay and independent/native Git object hashing passed locally. Those checks establish byte and packaging integrity, not mathematical truth, remote publication or CI success. Draft publication only; no merge, release, DOI or outside outreach.

Base commit: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`.
